name: popover
title: Popover
description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

files.content:
Class form

popover attribute + np-popover. The button uses popovertarget.

Dimensions

Set the dimensions for the layer.

Data-attribute form

data-np-popover and its parts.

Data attributes

Same look with data-np-popover-*.

Align

data-align start, center or end.

Aligned to start

Its left edge lines up with the trigger.

Aligned to center

It is centered on the trigger.

Aligned to end

Its right edge lines up with the trigger.

Side

data-side top, right, bottom or left. It flips when there is no room.

Top

Opens above the trigger.

Right

Opens to the right.

Bottom

Opens below the trigger.

Left

Opens to the left.

With form

Focus moves to the first field when it opens.

Dimensions

Set the dimensions for the layer.

Close button

Close it from inside.

Close button

A button with popovertargetaction="hide" closes it.

Manual

Stays open until closed.

popover="manual"

It does not close on outside click or Escape. Use the button.

Variables

Set them on the popover.

Custom look

Width, radius, padding and speed are variables.
